name: Delaryn's Demise
summary: Delaryn's Demise is a somber stretch along the windswept coastline of Mist's Edge in Darkshore. In the early days of 25 ADP, this quiet western shore remains largely untouched, known primarily to local Sentinels and fishermen walking the foggy sands. To those walking Darkshore's coastline today, it is merely another parcel of the mist-shrouded frontier.

sections.title: A Quiet Coastline
sections.body: Situated west of the beachheads near Mist's Edge, this shore sits under the shadow of ancient Kalimdor's fog. In the current era, the coastline is dominated by stranded sea creatures, encroaching murlocs, and the vigil of the night elven Sentinels who patrol south from Auberdine. While later legends speak of tragic confrontations on this very soil, travelers today find only the relentless crashing of the western tides against cold stones.

faq.answer: It refers to a specific stretch of shoreline along Mist's Edge in northern Darkshore. In the era of 25 ADP, it is simply an unassuming coastal expanse watched over by local night elf sentries and scavenged by coastal wildlife.
Delaryn Summermoon is a night elf Sentinel officer whose fate becomes tied to the shoreline in later historical accounts. Currently, the shore shows none of the grim aftermath tied to her name.

faq.q: Why is the area named this way if nothing has happened yet?
aliases: why is it named delaryns demise
faq.answer: Cartographers and chroniclers occasionally mark landmarks in advance of or reflecting tragic conflicts. For an adventurer in the current year, the sands are merely part of the untamed coastline of Darkshore.

angles.text: The wild, mist-covered beaches of Darkshore remain sacred sovereign territory of the kaldorei, guarded fiercely against hostile intruders from the sea.
Controlling the coastal waters and keeping communication open between Auberdine and neighboring territories is vital for maintaining Darnassus's security.
